$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for DEXI-10 flight-controller parameters. The .params files in dexi-10/ are GENERATED from this file by tools/gen-params.mjs. Never hand-edit them. DEXI-10 is a Pixhawk 6X and shares NO blocks with DEXI-3 (different board, different serial ports, and a DEXI-3 tune on a 10-inch airframe is a crash).
name: DEXI-10

boardDefaults.$comment: Params true of every DEXI-10 with this board and this wiring.

ports.doc: Serial port assignment for the Pixhawk 6X. REQUIRES this wiring: dexi-gps on the GPS2 port, CRSF receiver on TELEM3. Both are 6-pin JST-GH so the cables simply trade places. The dexi-gps CANNOT go on TELEM3: v6X TELEM pins 4/5 are CTS/RTS, not SCL/SDA, so its IST8310 compass is electrically unreachable there. Verified on hardware 2026-08-07.

params.name: GPS_1_CONFIG
params.note: GPS driver on the GPS2 port (/dev/ttyS7). This is the PRIMARY instance on the GPS2 port, so it is GPS_1_CONFIG=202, never GPS_2_CONFIG. A secondary instance never reaches the EKF.

params.name: RC_CRSF_PRT_CFG
params.note: CRSF receiver on TELEM3 (/dev/ttyS1). CRSF needs only TX/RX so a UART-only port suits it, which frees GPS2 for the GPS. NEVER set this to 0 on DEXI-10: unlike DEXI-3, this build has no rc_input driver, so crsf_rc is the only receiver driver present and 0 would disable RC entirely.

rc.doc: Pilot authority. This block is what makes the profile safe to hand to someone: a 3-position mode switch to leave Position hold, and a kill switch. Without it a freshly flashed aircraft has NO mode or kill switch. That is not hypothetical: DEXI-3 shipped exactly that way when one provisioning path skipped the RC map.

params.name: RC_MAP_ARM_SW
params.note: CH5 arm switch.

params.name: COM_ARM_SWISBTN
params.note: The arm switch is a 2-position toggle, not a momentary button.

params.name: RC_ARMSWITCH_TH
params.note: Asserted so a freshly flashed aircraft arms deterministically instead of inheriting a stray threshold.

params.name: RC_MAP_FLTMODE
params.note: CH6 3-position mode switch. This is the pilot's primary takeover: drop out of Position into Altitude or Stabilized.

params.name: RC_MAP_KILL_SW
params.note: CH8 kill switch. The last-resort takeover. Omitting this is what leaves a drone with no way to stop the motors.

params.name: RC_KILLSWITCH_TH
params.note: Asserted so kill behaviour is deterministic on a freshly flashed aircraft.

params.name: COM_FLTMODE1
params.note: Switch DOWN = Stabilized. PX4 splits the mode channel into 6 slots and a 3-position switch lands on slots 1/4/6, NOT 1/2/3. Filling 1/2/3 leaves the middle and top positions dead, which would strand a pilot in Position hold.

params.name: COM_FLTMODE4
params.note: Switch CENTRE = Altitude.

params.name: COM_FLTMODE6
params.note: Switch UP = Position. This is the mode the 2026-08-09 validation flight flew.

external-compass.doc: External magnetometer on the dexi-gps daughterboard (IST8310, I2C 0x0E, reached over the GPS2 port's I2C lines). Do NOT hardcode CAL_MAGn_ROT here: rotation is detected per-airframe by QGC compass calibration. On the first validated build it came out ROTATION_NONE with the orientation triangle to the nose and the cable out the tail.

params.name: EKF2_MAG_TYPE
params.note: Auto. The external mag on the GPS mast is clean enough outdoors.

params.name: SENS_MAG_AUTOROT
params.note: Let compass calibration detect and write CAL_MAGn_ROT. Keep this on so a new board self-detects rather than inheriting another airframe's answer.

params.name: SENS_EXT_I2C_PRB
params.note: Probe external I2C buses, which is how the IST8310 is found at all.

params.name: UAVCAN_SUB_MAG
params.note: No DroneCAN compass is fitted. Leaving this on lets a stale DroneCAN calibration slot masquerade as an enabled compass, which is what produced 'Found 0 compass (required: 1)' on 2026-08-07. Re-enable only if a DroneCAN compass is actually refitted.

outdoor-gps-nav.doc: GPS + external compass outdoor navigation, exactly as flown on 2026-08-09. Deliberately carries NO geofence and NO reduced speed limits. This is a validation and testing configuration: the pilot is the safety system, via the mode and kill switches in the rc block.

params.name: EKF2_GPS_CTRL
params.note: Fuse GPS horizontal position, altitude and 3D velocity. This is what makes Position hold work.

params.name: EKF2_HGT_REF
params.note: GPS as the primary height reference.

params.name: EKF2_BARO_CTRL
params.note: Keep baro fused alongside GPS height.

params.name: EKF2_GPS_CHECK
params.note: All pre-flight GNSS quality checks on. If Position mode will not engage, read estimator_gps_status to see WHICH check fails rather than lowering the bar; a lone max_pdop failure with everything else passing means poor sky view, not a bad param.

params.name: EKF2_EV_CTRL
params.note: No external vision outdoors.

params.name: EKF2_OF_CTRL
params.note: No optical flow outdoors.

params.name: EKF2_RNG_CTRL
params.note: No range-finder aiding outdoors.

params.name: COM_ARM_WO_GPS
params.note: Deliberately permissive, and it matches what flew. Arming is NOT blocked on a GPS fix, so the aircraft can still be armed in Stabilized or Altitude on the bench or without sky view. This cannot get you airborne in Position on a bad fix: Position mode independently requires a valid position estimate before PX4 will enter it.

profiles.name: DEXI-10 Outdoor (GPS) — Complete Setup
profiles.description: Plug in the dexi-gps, flash this, go. GPS + external-compass outdoor flight for the DEXI-10 on a Pixhawk 6X, exactly as flight-validated on 2026-08-09. Includes the RC map, so a pilot always has a 3-position mode switch to leave Position hold and a kill switch. Requires the dexi-gps on GPS2 and the CRSF receiver on TELEM3.
details: Ports: GPS on GPS2 (GPS_1_CONFIG = 202), CRSF receiver on TELEM3 (RC_CRSF_PRT_CFG = 103)
Pilot authority: CH6 3-position mode switch (down Stabilized / centre Altitude / up Position) and CH8 kill switch
Horizontal + height: GPS (EKF2_GPS_CTRL = 7, EKF2_HGT_REF = 1) for Position hold
Heading: external IST8310 on the dexi-gps board (EKF2_MAG_TYPE = 0)
Indoor aiding off: optical flow, external vision and range all disabled
NO geofence and NO reduced speed limits. Validation and testing config; the pilot is the safety system
Arming is not blocked on GPS (COM_ARM_WO_GPS = 1), so Stabilized bench work still works
Run QGC compass calibration after fitting the board; rotation is detected, not hardcoded
Flight tune comes from the 4019 airframe, so this profile does not set one
